an11.2:1.1: 2 sīlavato bhikkhave sīlasampannassa na cetanāya karaṇīyaṃ
an11.2:1.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yaṃ sīlavato sīlasampannassa avippaṭisāro uppajjati
an11.2:2.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yaṃ avippaṭisārissa pāmujjaṃ uppajjati
an11.2:3.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yaṃ pamuditassa pīti uppajjati
an11.2:4.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yaṃ pītimanassa kāyo passambhati
an11.2:5.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yaṃ passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyati
an11.2:6.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yaṃ sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati
an11.2:7.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yaṃ samāhito yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti passati
an11.2:8.1: yathābhūtaṃ bhikkhave jānato passato na cetanāya karaṇīyaṃ
an11.2:8.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yaṃ yathābhūtaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ nibbindati
an11.2:9.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yaṃ nibbinno virajjati
an11.2:10.3: dhammatā esā bhikkhave yaṃ virato vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ sacchikaroti
an11.2:11.1: iti kho bhikkhave virāgo vimuttiñāṇadassanattho vimuttiñāṇadassanānisaṃso nibbidā virāgatthā virāgānisaṃsā yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbidatthaṃ nibbidānisaṃsaṃ samādhi yathābhūtañāṇadassanattho yathābhūtañāṇadassanānisaṃso sukhaṃ samādhatthaṃ samādhānisaṃsaṃ passaddhi sukhatthā sukhānisaṃsā pīti passaddhatthā passaddhānisaṃsā pāmujjaṃ pītatthaṃ pītānisaṃsaṃ avippaṭisāro pāmujjattho pāmujjānisaṃso kusalāni sīlāni avippaṭisāratthāni avippaṭisārānisaṃsāni
an11.2:11.2: iti kho bhikkhave dhammā dhamme abhisandenti dhammā dhamme paripūrenti apārā pāragamanāyāti.
